title: 22 January 1964:Live: Olympia Theatre, Paris
content:
The Beatles performed two more shows on this day during their Parisian residency. This was day six of the 18-date run at the Olympia Theatre.

The group’s setlist contained eight songs: ‘From Me To You’, ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘She Loves You’, ‘This Boy’, ‘Boys’, ‘I Want To Hold Your Hand’, ‘Twist And Shout’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

Also on this day...

  • 1979: Recording: Goodnight Tonight by Wings
  • 1976: Recording: Beware My Love by Wings
  • 1975: Geoff Britton is fired from Wings
  • 1975: Recording: Venus And Mars (Reprise) by Wings
  • 1973: Recording, mixing: Night Out, Get On The Right Thing by Wings
  • 1971: Recording: Power To The People by John Lennon/Plastic Ono Band
  • 1971: Recording: Power To The People by John Lennon/Plastic Ono Band
  • 1971: Recording: When The Wind Is Blowing by Paul McCartney
  • 1970: Ringo Starr has dinner with Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day 13
  • 1968: Apple opens offices at 95 Wigmore Street, London
  • 1966: George and Pattie Harrison hold a press conference
  • 1963: Radio: The Talent Spot
  • 1963: Radio: Saturday Club
  • 1963: Radio: Pop Inn
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Kingsway Club, Southport
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
